bosses.name: Pebble Pup
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A squat river-stone puppy with a moss saddle, floppy stone ears and a wagging crystal tail.

bosses.name: Lantern Snail
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A tiny amber snail carrying a copper lantern shell. Its eye stalks tilt and the shell glows when it reacts.

bosses.name: Bramble Knight
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A broad wooden knight with a living fern crest, a buckler and an attached root blade. A forest guardian rather than a humanoid covered in random moss.

bosses.name: Copper Scuttler
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A little clockwork crab with two articulated claws, bright cyan eyes, and a copper winding key. It scuttles sideways and clicks its claws.

bosses.name: Sporeback
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A gentle-looking mushroom troll with a red cap, a stout body, short rooted feet and a movable under-cap mouth. The big silhouette stays readable.

bosses.name: Moss Bat
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A rounded cave bat with leaf-shaped wings, a small pale muzzle and two amber eyes. Previewed as a tiny flying creature.

bosses.name: Hornroot Guardian
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A stocky horned guardian inspired by the minotaur reference: pale horns, a heavy wooden chest and rooted legs. It braces its arms before a charge.

bosses.name: Marsh Oracle
bosses.title: Original draft · not installed
bosses.description: A squat frog seer with a reed hood and a warm lantern staff. Its cheeks puff, its jaw moves, and the staff stays in its hand.
